chapters.title: Challenges of DAO
chapters.content: ## Challenges of DAO - Organizational element: someone needs to organize. Often hard to get a dedicated person to do operations. Need people who would do this any way and are people persons. - Operational porousness: DAOs need to be porous where anyone can come in and contribute - Over-commodification. Too gamified and not open to any people. - UX of Integration of Web3: Building proofing mechanisms into habits of activity and ease of funding. - Lack of Funding: their is a lack of funding opportuntieis and doing the things and organizing it takes money.

chapters.title: We like Games, Games Are Activities, But People Will Try to PLay Games with You
chapters.content:
### We like Games, Games Are Activities, But People Will Try to PLay Games with You Identifying Grifters - starting out with non financial. Governance Attacks

Case Studies

Already in the wild there has been communities centered around doing the activity. See [DAOs](https://activity.community/daos) here (for updated list) Activity DAO

Current ActivityDAOs to date mostly are food based, comes from nouns ecosystem, or are adjacent communities. Since many use Nouns mechanism, they have shared treasury, a replanishing mechanisms through nft sales, and governance through nft ownership. However their is disconnect on proofing the thing, and rather it just serves as re-up mechanism. Their is also disconnect. Many others are also activites at events like SpaDAO or SaunaDAO, but lack sophisticated on chain presences.

chapters.title: The Evolution of Activity DAO Movement
chapters.content:
# The Evolution of Activity DAO Movement This is the start of a routine for a better life. An intention-setting session for the entire ecosystem to change the ways we fundamentally do gathering in the industry, export fun, and integrate decentralized technology to proliferate communities around doing…by doing things. First we are just putting out the concept, recognizing Web3 communities that resemble activities DAOs, at events that fall under the guidelinee. Then at some network state movements and conferences we are going to incubate different communities. All the while we are hacking out a launchpad to streamline proof and funding mechanisms to coordinate activitiy DAOs. If you are interested please join our discord Phase 1: Concept & Aggregation:\{WE ARE HERE NOW\} → Handbook, Directory, Interest Form Phase 2: Interest & Incubation: → Coordinate Cohort of Activity & GTM at Web3, Conferences, Event Directory Phase 3: Scale & Deployment: → Build Activity DAO launch pad.

Activitiy DAO launchpad. Way to coordinate funding. Tools to build custom Proof of Activity.

Understanding the Launchpad. Based on how activities roll out wee will be aggregating different coordination, events, funding and activity based tools to continue to guide communities on how to build a more native stack and build this into the activity DAO app as it evolves.
